accessibility.target: WCAG 2.2 AA for the browser control-plane surface

design_system.component_source: src/local_llm_server/static/design-system.css with source-backed renderers under src/local_llm_server/static/control-plane-*.js and components.js

critical_journeys.name: Open the control plane, understand server/runtime status and navigate between core surfaces
Configure a model request, submit inference, observe progress/failure and recover for the next request
Understand model availability/residency and perform an intentional runtime-management action
Start/review evaluation state and inspect comparable result/history information without confusing unavailable data with zero

reference_views: implemented control-plane shell and overview sources under src/local_llm_server/static/control-plane-*
implemented Local LLM Studio chat/configuration surface in src/local_llm_server/static/index.html
critical loading/empty/error/status source states covered by tests/e2e and tests/test_accessibility_ui_assets.py

validation.accessibility_automation: pytest -q tests/test_accessibility_ui_assets.py plus Playwright critical-journey assertions
validation.visual_regression: n/a for current unstable/incidental pixels; semantic visual contracts and design-system drift are blocking, pixel baselines are added only for stable high-risk surfaces
